reviewScope: Full command, service and renderer; planner API and filesystem/workspace/filter call sites; test fixture and executed suite.
Schema helpers, full planner algorithms and external package dependencies remain incomplete.

classification.default: Mutating configuration synchronization, not qualified for reuse.
classification.check: Filesystem-dependent fresh drift verdict; no planned writes, but the complete transitive input boundary is not established.
classification.dry-run: Filesystem-dependent plan and logs; no planned writes.

findings: Command discovers repository root and selects mode from flags; no exclusive matching flag pattern defaults to sync.
Service discovers all workspaces and dependency graph and rejects cycles before planning.
Root references, aliases and syncpack are planned without the package filter; filter only selects package reference, check-overlay and docgen planners.
Check overlays consume newly planned canonical content when present, avoiding one-run lag.

Only sync writes sorted planned changes; check renders drift before returning a typed drift error. A write failure can leave an earlier subset written: no transaction or rollback is shown in the service.

Planner inputs include workspace manifests and exports, filesystem discovery, owner tsconfigs, check/docgen file existence, existing references and path resolution, root tsconfig.packages.json, tsconfig.json and syncpack.config.ts.
Rendered paths are relative to root but planner/errors may carry absolute paths; output safety is not established by relative summaries.
The temporary test harness changes process cwd and restores it; these tests are not cross-process or concurrent-cache evidence.
remaining: Transitive repo-utils discovery/dependency-index/process effects and full schema/planner semantics require further review.
All 14 census obligations remain; no signed remote receipt, qualification transition or cache policy change.
